mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in GDPC1, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 YoY growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises by more than 0.5pp over 3 months, it signals a weakening labor market and potential economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp over 3 months but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 4.5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that will slow economic growth and produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4.5% but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) decline by more than 10% year-over-year, it signals a weakening housing market and consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST declines > 10% YoY but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) grows by more than 200,000 jobs in a month, it signals a tight labor market and potential wage inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 4% and PAYEMS growth > 200k in 1 month
failure_condition: UNRATE < 4% and PAYEMS growth > 200k in 1 month, but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) declines by more than 0.5% month-over-month, it signals a weakening manufacturing sector and potential economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO declines > 0.5% MoM but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) grow by more than 5% year-over-year, it signals strong consumer demand and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS grows > 5% YoY but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) rises by more than 0.5% month-over-month, it signals increasing inflationary pressures that may prompt monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL rises > 0.5% MoM but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.
